tei:div.tei:p: "!#༁ྃ: ḍā ki'i snyan brgyud zab mo las: rjes su gnang ba mkha' 'gro srog gi tha rams bzhugs so:

srung zlog gsad gsum gyi rjes gnang: ྈྈྈྈྈ bdud 'dul ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro ma la phyag 'tshal lo: ḍā ki'i snyan brgyud zab mo las: las thams cad kyi rjes su gnang ba mkha' 'gro kun gyi srog gi tha rams ni: dang po srung ba'i rjes su gnang ba ni/ rdo rje'i lte bar hūm̐ dmar pos mtshan pa'i mtha' skor du: rdo rje me ris bskor ba slob bu'i mgo la bzhag nas: hūm̐: srung ba 'jigs med rdo rje 'di: skal ldan bu rnams bar chad mi tshugs pa'i: sra brtan rdo rje 'bar ba che: rdo rje 'bar bas rgyas gdab bo: 'jigs pa kun las skyob par shog: rtsa sngags zhi drag sham du: ma ma rak+ṣa rak+ṣa hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐: zhes srung ba rdo rje pha lam gyi dbang bskur pas: pha rol gyi byad kha rbod gtong thams cad skyob pa'i mthu stobs dang ldan par gyur cig: me tog gi char phab bo: ྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈ s+ya mya y+ya: ༈ de nas zlog pa'i rjes su gnang ba ni: gser gyi tsakra rtsibs brgyad pa'i lte bar hūm̐ māṃ gyis mtshan pa dang: gnam lcags kyi tsakra rtsibs brgyad dbang phyug gi mtshan ma gnyis kyis dbang bskur la: hūm̐: ḍā ki stobs ldan thogs med kyi: ldog med stobs chen 'khor lo 'dis: skal ldan bu la dbang bskur bas: 'jigs pa'i rbod gtong zlog pa dang: mi mthun phyogs las rgyal bar shog: yi ge bcu bzhi'i sham bu: ḍā ki sarba duṣ+ṭān byad ma rbod gtong thams cad e sa bh+yo bh+yo zlog zlog: zlog pa stobs ldan tsakra'i dbang bskur pas: 'byung ba bzhi yi gnod pa zlog pa dang: pha rol gyi byad kha rbod gtong thams cad zlog pa'i stobs dang ldan par gyur cig: ces me tog gtor: ྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈ s+ya mya y+ya: rgya rgya rgya: ༈ de nas gsod pa'i rjes su gnang ba sbyin pa ni: lcags sam seng ldeng phur pa mkha' 'gro'i sgrub rten seng zhal can dang: gri thod gru gsum gtad la: hūm̐: stobs ldan mkha' 'gro'i phyag mtshan 'di:

zhing bcu bsgral ba srog gi spu gri yin: skal ldan bu yi phyag gi mtshan tu gtad: dregs pa can rnams ma lus 'dul ba dang: zhing bcu bsgral ba'i las rnams 'grub par shog: aḥkaḥsaḥmaḥraḥtsaḥshaḥdaḥraḥsaḥmaḥraḥyaḥphaṭa: dgra bgegs byad ma gnod byed kyi srog la mā ra ya rbad rbad: ces bsad pa spu gri'i 'khor lo'i rjes su gnang bas: bstan pa la gnod pa'i zhing bcur gyur pa thams cad bsgral ba'i las la thogs pa med par 'grub pa'i stobs dang ldan par gyur cig: ces me tog gtor: 'grub par gyur cig: de bzhin du 'grub par gyur cig: su pra tiṣ+ṭha badz+rā ya swā hā: zhes bkra shis brjod: ྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈ ྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈ 'di ltar dbang gzhung rgyas bsdus gang yin kyang: rjes su gnang ba dam ldan bu la sbyin: srung zlog bsad gsum gnang ba 'di med na: las byed 'dod pa byis pa ngal ba'i rgyu: srung ba'i gnang ba ma thob na: gcer bu g.yul du zhugs pa 'dra: zlog pa'i gnang ba ma thob na: btsan po rgyab med dbang yod byas pa 'dra: bsad pa'i gnang ba ma thob na: shed med stag dang sbar 'dzings 'dra: bla ma dam pa ma bsten na: man ngag gzer thig thob mi 'gyur: yo byad mthun rkyen med pa na: phun sum tshogs pa'i chos mi thob: slob dpon bsnyen bkur ma nus na: man ngag gsang mdzod thob pa med: dad pa gding nas ma skyes na: kha gsag byin rlabs zhugs pa med: sgrub pa snying nas ma byas na: le los dngos grub thob pa med: yi dam rtse gcig ma bsgrub na: ye shes mkha' 'gro 'grub mi srid: byams dang snying rje ma bsgom na: spyod pa mu stegs 'chor nyen yod: gsal stong zung 'jug ma bsgom na: lta bas thag chod 'chor nyen yod: bskyed rdzogs zung 'jug ma shes na: sgom pa a 'thas 'byams nyen yod: mkha' 'gro rang sems ma shes na: 'bras bu gzhan smon lus nyen yod: de phyir bla ma dam pa bsten: man ngag snying po sgrub la brtson:

las sbyor stong nyid snying rje bsgom: yo byad yi dam mkha' 'gro mchod: de byas mkha' 'gro ngang gis 'grub: phrin las rtsol med lhun grub 'byung: de phyir phyi rabs skal ldan rnams: nyams len snying po 'di la dril: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya:
